items.title: 台积电 (TSM) — 2026年第三季度 财报分析 | Aardvark Labs Capital Research
items.author: Aardvark Labs
items.highlights: - 又一次超预期，这次靠的是经营。营收$46.72B（NT$1,494.24B），比$44.6–45.8B指引上限高出2.0%；营业利润率58.7%，超过58.0%的上限；ADR EPS为$4.60，比约$4.45–4.46的一致预期高约3%。营业外收入从Q2的NT$95.8B回落到NT$34.6B，所以和Q2不同，本季度的盈利增长来自晶圆，而不是利息和投资收益。 ... $53.3B的中值环比+14%，同比+58%，比市场在财报前预期的约$50.2–50.5B高出约6%。 - 毛利率五个季度来首次落在指引区间内。 66.4%的毛利率（环比下降130bp）反映了管理层7月已提示的N2摊薄：N2占晶圆营收的比例从3%跳升到8%。Q4指引65–67%，守住60%区间中段；海外晶圆厂的摊薄目前更接近2%，之后几年会扩大到3–4%。这是公司史上最快制程爬坡的预期成本，并不意外。 - 管理层把消费端的谨慎放在了2027年，市场照样抛售AI。消费类和价格敏感型业务因零部件涨价而“面临挑战”，所以台积电对2027年的规划保持“审慎”，而AI需求则看不到任何“放缓迹象”。ADR当天下跌1.8%，两个交易日累计下跌4.0%，与SMH半导体ETF因AI融资担忧下跌4.4%基本一致。 ... items.highlights: Issued by: TSMC Issued on: 2026/10/15 HSINCHU, Taiwan, R.O.C., Oct. 15, 2026 -- TSMC (TWSE: 2330, NYSE: TSM) today announced consolidated revenue of NT$1,494.24 billion, net income of NT$763.06 billion, and diluted earnings per share of NT$29.43 (US$4.60 per ADR unit) for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. Year-over-year, third quarter revenue increased 50.9%, while net income and diluted EPS both increased 68.7%. items.title: TSMC Sinks 20% in a Week on Nvidia Jitters and New US Chip Curbs on China. Time to Buy?
items.author: Wiltone Asuncion
items.highlights: **Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing** **(**TSM:NYSE **)** stock fell 20% in the week ended Nov. 20, and most of the damage started outside its own business. Chip stocks slid on Monday, Nov. 16, ahead of the first earnings report from **Nvidia** **(**NVDA:NASDAQ **)** since Jensen Huang resigned as CEO. The same day, the Trump administration said it would further restrict China's access to advanced AI chips.
